issues.description: Customers repeatedly cannot log in or recover their accounts despite correct passwords, with verification emails, reset links, and phone-number checks failing.
issues.name: Users locked out of accounts during login

issues.description: Many customers report being locked out, repeatedly asked to sign in, or unable to open the app at all, despite valid accounts.
issues.name: Users unable to log in or access account

issues.description: Many customers report being unable to log in or being logged out, especially via phone number, with errors like something went wrong and failed login attempts.
issues.name: Users unable to log in

issues.description: Many customers report that account creation and signup fail with errors, generic 'something went wrong' messages, or repeated retry prompts, blocking them from using the app.
issues.name: Users cannot sign up or create accounts

issues.description: Customers cannot sign in or link accounts through Facebook or Google, with login crashes, hanging screens, and generic error messages blocking access to the app.
issues.name: Third-party login failures for Facebook and Google

issues.description: Customers feel pressured to pay through persistent payment reminders, unexpected or duplicate charges, and paywalled basic features.
issues.name: Unexpected charges and payment prompts

issues.description: Customers feel that core features like skips, repeat, shuffle, and choosing songs now require a paid subscription, which they find frustrating.
issues.name: Basic features locked behind payment

issues.description: Free users report that core features such as song selection, skips, lyrics, and playlists were restricted to Premium subscribers after an update, leading many to feel forced to pay or to leave the app.
issues.name: Basic features locked behind premium paywall

issues.description: Many users say the Spotify premium subscription costs too much, especially after price increases and restricted free features, so they cannot afford it and are considering leaving.
issues.name: Premium subscription price too high

issues.description: Free users find core functions such as shuffle control, seeking within songs, lyrics, and skipping restricted or pushed toward paid premium after an update.
issues.name: Basic features locked behind premium subscription

issues.description: Users report that many songs, artists, and genres they expect are unavailable or have been removed from the catalog.
issues.name: Missing songs and limited catalog selection

issues.description: Customers report that song lyrics fail to appear or load for many tracks, sometimes even for premium subscribers, after a recent update.
issues.name: Lyrics not loading or missing

issues.description: Users report that many favorite songs, artists, and label catalogs (such as Zee Music) have been removed or are unavailable, even from their playlists.
issues.name: Songs and artists missing from catalog

issues.description: Customers say the app's song suggestions, autoplay, shuffle, and home-page recommendations repeat the same tracks or feel irrelevant to their tastes and genres.
issues.name: Repetitive or irrelevant music recommendations

issues.description: Users report that searching for specific songs, albums, or artists returns missing, incorrect, or unrelated results, and that searched tracks sometimes do not play.
issues.name: Search fails to find or play requested songs

issues.description: Users report that downloaded or saved songs, albums, and podcasts vanish from their devices without their consent and often cannot be re-downloaded, breaking offline listening.
issues.name: Downloaded songs disappearing unexpectedly

issues.description: Users report that downloads will not start or complete, and downloaded songs become unplayable offline, requiring internet or a premium subscription.
issues.name: Downloaded songs fail to download or play

issues.description: Users report that downloaded or saved songs disappear, fail to play without WiFi, or cannot be downloaded at all, especially after app updates.
issues.name: Downloaded songs missing or unplayable offline

issues.description: Users who downloaded music or playlists for offline listening find the app cannot play or load them when there is no connection, so the premium offline feature does not work.
issues.name: Offline playback fails without internet connection

issues.description: Users express broad negative sentiment about the app, often citing recent updates, bugs, or poor overall quality without a specific feature identified.
issues.name: General dissatisfaction with app after updates

issues.description: Users report the app glitching, lagging, crashing, cutting out music, and delivering low or weak audio quality during playback.
issues.name: Playback glitches, lag, and poor audio quality

issues.description: Users report the app claims no or poor internet, stalls, or refuses to play or connect to devices even when their network and other apps work fine.
issues.name: Playback fails despite good connectivity

issues.description: Users report the app frequently crashes, freezes, or goes black mid-playback and during loading, forcing restarts or reinstalls and disrupting listening.
issues.name: App crashes and freezes during playback

issues.description: Users report music and podcasts that stop, won't start, play the wrong track, or show a black screen, often needing a device restart or reinstall to recover.
issues.name: Playback failures and wrong or stalled audio

issues.description: Users report the app draining battery and mobile data, and playback that stutters, cuts out, or plays unexpectedly in the background or after the car is turned off.
issues.name: Playback drains battery and data, audio cuts out

issues.description: Users report that music or podcasts stop playing on their own, often after minutes or a few tracks, requiring them to restart the app, especially with the screen off or when multitasking.
issues.name: Music playback stops unexpectedly

issues.description: Customers report that support is unresponsive, unhelpful, or inaccessible, with emails, comments, and calls going unanswered and issues left unresolved.
issues.name: Poor customer support responsiveness and help access

issues.description: Customers report that Spotify support is unresponsive, hard to reach through chatbots or circular options, and fails to resolve or answer their issues.
issues.name: Unresponsive customer support and hard-to-reach help

issues.description: Users report too many back-to-back, long, or unskippable ads that interrupt listening and break promised ad-free time.
issues.name: Excessive ads interrupting music listening

issues.description: Users report that the app auto-selects and plays songs or podcasts they did not choose, disrupting playback control, and that basic features like ordered playback and skipping have been restricted.
issues.name: Autoplay overrides user song choices and queue

issues.description: Users report that playing their own playlists or queued songs routes to shuffled or recommended tracks not in their chosen selection, and playlists gain songs they did not add.
issues.name: Playlist playback plays unwanted songs

issues.description: Users report they cannot choose specific songs, turn off shuffle, repeat tracks, or skip freely, so playback often picks unwanted songs instead of the one they selected.
issues.name: Loss of playback control and shuffle choice

issues.description: After a recent update, users report that core playback controls like shuffle, repeat, track selection, and history were removed or hidden, and the redesigned home page is harder to navigate.
issues.name: Post-update UI removes playback controls and features
